# oc-omniroute-plugin [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin.svg?color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/@devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin) [![CI Status](https://github.com/devararishivian/opencode-omniroute/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/devararishivian/opencode-omniroute/actions) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![OpenCode](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCode-v2-black.svg)](https://opencode.ai) A fast, clean OpenCode V2 plugin for [OmniRoute](https://github.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute). It connects OpenCode directly to your OmniRoute gateway, keeps your model picker clean and organized, and optionally adds fast web search and web fetch tools using OmniRoute's REST API.


Clean model picker with organized provider naming, effort tiers, and free-tier badges


Seamless integration inside OpenCode TUI active session

```sh # Inside your project directory (or in ~/.config/opencode for global setup): bun add -d @devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin # or: npm install -D @devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin ``` ```json { "plugins": [ { "package": "@devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin", "options": { "baseURL": "https://your-omniroute-gateway.com", "apiKey": "your-api-key" } } ] } ``` --- ## Why Use This Plugin? The standard `/v1/models` endpoint from a gateway often contains hundreds of raw models. This can clutter your editor with image generators, embeddings, and duplicate rows. This plugin fixes those problems automatically: - **Chat models only (Clean Picker)** Filters out non-chat models that you cannot use for coding or conversation. Image generators (`flux`, `ali-qwen-image-*`), text embeddings (`text-embedding-3`, `nemotron-embed`), audio, video, and rerank models are automatically removed. - **No duplicate rows (Smart Tier Folding)** Gateways often list flat effort rows like `claude-opus-5-low`, `claude-opus-5-medium`, and `claude-opus-5-high`. This plugin folds them into a single base model (`claude-opus-5`) and exposes the effort levels inside OpenCode's native variant selector. - **Full Thinking / Reasoning control** Reads reasoning effort tiers directly from OmniRoute. You can easily switch thinking levels (`low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`) right from the OpenCode interface. - **Clean, searchable titles** Models are named with a provider-first format: `CustomProvider - Deepseek v4.1 Flash`. - Cleans up ugly repository prefixes (e.g. `nvidia/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash` becomes `Nvidia - Deepseek v4.1 Flash`). - Preserves special routing wrappers clearly (e.g. `No-think - CustomProvider - Claude Opus 5`). - Makes searching in the model picker fast and natural. - **No fake "Free" badges** OpenCode shows a `Free` tag on models with zero pricing. When a gateway does not send price data for private or custom connections, other plugins leave the price at 0, falsely labeling expensive models as "Free". This plugin leaves unpriced models clean while keeping the `[Free]` label only on models that are genuinely free. - **Active connections only (`usableOnly`)** Enabled by default. It checks connection status and hides upstream providers that are disabled or unhealthy, while making sure active models remain available. - **Built-in REST Web Search & Fetch (No MCP required)** Give your AI agents real-time web access directly through OmniRoute's REST endpoints (`/v1/search` and `/v1/web/fetch`). - **Zero extra MCP servers**: No need to configure or run heavy background MCP daemons. - **High performance**: Fast HTTP REST calls managed by OmniRoute's built-in search engine integrations (Serper, Tavily, Firecrawl, Bing, etc.) with automatic upstream failover. - **Safe & resilient**: Enforces OpenCode's native permission checks before requesting any URL. If your gateway has a temporary outage, fetch automatically falls back to OpenCode's native web fetch tool. - **One key for everything** Uses one API key for inference (`/v1/*`), search/fetch, and metadata (`/api/*`). No separate management token is required. --- ## Installation & Setup ### Scenario A: New user (First time connecting OmniRoute) 1. **Install the plugin:** - **For a single project:** Run this command inside your project root folder (where your project's `opencode.json` lives): ```sh bun add -d @devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin # or npm install -D @devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin ``` - **For all projects (global):** Run this command inside your global OpenCode directory: ```sh cd ~/.config/opencode bun add -d @devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin # or: npm install -D @devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin ``` 2. **Add the plugin to `opencode.json`:** Open your project's `opencode.json` (or global `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`): ```json { "plugins": [ { "package": "@devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin", "options": { "baseURL": "https://omniroute.example.com", "apiKey": "your-api-key" } } ] } ``` *Tip: You can also set `OMNIROUTE_API_KEY` in your environment instead of writing your key in the config file.* --- ### Scenario B: You previously connected OmniRoute manually If you previously added OmniRoute under the `"provider"` block in `opencode.json`: ```jsonc // Remove or replace manual static provider configuration "provider": { "omniroute": { "npm": "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible", "options": { "baseURL": "...", "apiKey": "..." }, "models": { ... } } } ``` 1. Remove the static `"omniroute"` entry from `"provider"` in `opencode.json`. 2. Install the plugin in your project (or in `~/.config/opencode` for global use) as shown in Scenario A. 3. Add `@devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin` under `"plugins"` in `opencode.json`. 4. Restart OpenCode. The plugin will discover and configure your models automatically with live limits and capabilities. --- ### Scenario C: Migrating from `@omniroute/opencode-plugin-v2` If you used the earlier upstream plugin: 1. **Update your dependencies:** In the directory where you previously installed the plugin (your project root or `~/.config/opencode`): ```sh # Inside your project root or ~/.config/opencode: bun remove @omniroute/opencode-plugin-v2 && bun add -d @devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin # or npm uninstall @omniroute/opencode-plugin-v2 && npm install -D @devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin ``` 2. **In `opencode.json`:** - Change `"package": "@omniroute/opencode-plugin-v2"` to `"package": "@devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin"`. - Remove `"managementReadToken"` if you had it (this plugin only requires your standard `apiKey`). 3. **Delete the old snapshot file (run from any terminal directory):** ```sh rm -f ~/.local/share/opencode/plugins/omniroute-omniroute.json ``` 4. Restart OpenCode. --- ## How to Update To update the plugin to the latest version: - **If installed in a project:** Run inside your project root folder: ```sh bun update @devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin # or npm update @devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin ``` - **If installed globally:** Run inside your global config folder: ```sh cd ~/.config/opencode && bun update @devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin # or cd ~/.config/opencode && npm update @devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin ``` If you ever want to force OpenCode to immediately rebuild its cached model catalog, delete the snapshot cache and restart OpenCode (**run from any directory**): ```sh rm -f ~/.local/share/opencode/plugins/omniroute-omniroute.json ``` --- ## OmniRoute MCP Server Notice **This plugin does NOT require OmniRoute MCP.** - This plugin communicates directly with OmniRoute using high-performance HTTP REST endpoints. - **Can you still use OmniRoute MCP?** Yes! If you use OmniRoute's MCP server for custom agent tools, you can keep it in your config. They operate independently and will not interfere with each other. --- ## Optional: Web Search & Fetch Tools (REST) OmniRoute can handle web searches and URL scraping directly via HTTP REST without running a separate MCP server. You can enable either or both tools: ```json { "plugins": [ { "package": "@devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin", "options": { "baseURL": "https://omniroute.example.com", "apiKey": "your-api-key", "web": { "search": { "enabled": true, "maxResults": 5 }, "fetch": { "enabled": true, "fallbackToNative": true, "includeMetadata": true }, "timeoutMs": 30000 } } } ] } ``` ### How `web.search` Works - Registers OmniRoute as an active search provider in OpenCode via `ctx.websearch`. - Routes query requests to `POST /v1/search`. - Parses search results, snippets, full markdown content (e.g. from Tavily, Serper, Firecrawl), and publication dates into OpenCode's native search result structure. - Rejects empty or whitespace-only queries client-side before sending network requests. - Capped by `maxResults` (default: 5). ### How `web.fetch` Works - Replaces OpenCode's built-in `webfetch` tool in the tool registry. - Routes URL fetch requests to `POST /v1/web/fetch`. - **Security First**: Always asserts the native OpenCode `webfetch` permission before making any HTTP request. If permission is denied, no network call is ever made. - **Graceful Fallback**: If `fallbackToNative: true` (default), any gateway outage or upstream error automatically falls back to OpenCode's native fetch implementation so your agent tasks never fail. - **Cancellation & Timeout**: Respects per-request caller timeouts (1..120 seconds) and cleanly stops without fallback if the turn was cancelled by the user. Both tools are **disabled by default**. --- ## Full Configuration Options For advanced filtering and timeout options, check [docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md). Key options: - `baseURL` *(string, required)*: The URL of your OmniRoute instance. - `apiKey` *(string)*: Your OmniRoute gateway key (can also be set via `OMNIROUTE_API_KEY`). - `usableOnly` *(boolean, default: `true`)*: Filters out models from inactive or failed connections. - `enrichment` *(boolean, default: `true`)*: Fetches human-friendly names and live pricing metadata. - `visibleModels` *(string[], default: `["*"]`)*: Allowlist of models to show (supports exact IDs, suffixes, or branch wildcards like `openai/*`). - `hiddenModels` *(string[])*: Denylist of models to hide (supports exact IDs, suffixes, or branch wildcards like `google/*`). - `combos` *(boolean, default: `true`)*: Set to `false` to hide all combo models and skip combo metadata requests. - `freeOnly` *(boolean, default: `false`)*: Publish free-tier models only. - `freeSignals` *(string[], default: `["declared"]`)*: Signals for `freeOnly` inference (`"declared"`, `"priced"`, `"named"`, `"provider-named"`). - `web.search.enabled` *(boolean, default: `false`)*: Enables REST web search provider. - `web.fetch.enabled` *(boolean, default: `false`)*: Enables REST web fetch tool with native fallback. --- ## Compatibility & Requirements | Component | Minimum Version | Tested & Aligned Version | Notes | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **OpenCode V2** | `>=2.1.0` | `2.2.7` (also `2.2.0`–`2.2.6`) | `peerDependencies: "@opencode/plugin": ">=2.1.0 <3"` | | **OmniRoute Gateway** | `>=3.8.52` | `3.8.53` | Direct REST inference, pricing/metadata, and web tools | | **Runtime** | Node `>=22.22.3` / Bun `>=1.4.0` | Node `22.20.5` / Bun `1.4.4` | Node.js 22 LTS or modern Bun | --- ## Contributing Contributions, bug reports, and suggestions are welcome! 1. **Fork & Clone** the repository. 2. **Install dependencies**: ```sh bun install ``` 3. **Run tests**: ```sh bun run test ``` 4. **Check types & build**: ```sh bun run typecheck bun run build ``` 5. Create a branch and submit your Pull Request to the `develop` branch. Please make sure all tests pass before submitting. --- ## Issue Reporting & Support If you encounter a bug, an unhandled model format, or unexpected behavior: - Open an issue on [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/devararishivian/opencode-omniroute/issues). - Include your OpenCode version, OmniRoute gateway version, and a brief description of the issue. - **Security Reminder:** Never include your private API keys, bearer tokens, or sensitive endpoint URLs in issue descriptions or logs. --- ## Support, Star & Sponsor ⭐ If this plugin makes your OpenCode workflow smoother: - **Star the repository:** Give us a ⭐ on GitHub! It helps other developers find this project. - **Sponsor / Donate:** If this tool brings value to you or your company, consider sponsoring or supporting ongoing maintenance via [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/devararishivian) or donation links on the profile. Your support keeps the project active and independent! --- ## Acknowledgments & Credits This project was built upon and inspired by the work of the open-source community: - **[OmniRoute](https://github.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute)** by [Diego Souza](https://github.com/diegosouzapw) & contributors: This plugin is an independent derivative of the original `@omniroute/opencode-plugin-v2`. We are grateful for OmniRoute's powerful AI gateway and their initial OpenCode integration. - **[pi-omniroute-sync](https://github.com/JasonLandbridge/pi-omniroute-sync)** by [JasonLandbridge](https://github.com/JasonLandbridge), with displaying and custom-prefix discovery contributions by the author: Special thanks for inspiring key ideas around chat-only model filtering, dual-level effort tier discovery, and clean provider-first naming conventions. - **[OpenCode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode)**: For building an incredible, hackable coding agent harness and extensible plugin architecture. --- ## License & Disclaimer MIT License. # Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [0.1.4] - 2026-11-09

### Added

- Background catalog refresh loop aligning the served catalog with the gateway automatically over `modelCacheTtlMs`
  (minimum 60s period) without requiring an OpenCode service restart. *(Credit: Backported with attribution from
  upstream PR #18235 by @maxmad64bis, MIT License).*
- Branch wildcard filtering (`prefix/*`) in `visibleModels`, `hiddenModels`, and `providersAllow`, allowing entire
  provider branches (e.g. `anthropic/*`, `opencode-go/*`) to be included or excluded in a single entry.
- Option `combos` (boolean, default: `true`). Setting `combos: false` suppresses all combo publishing and skips
  `/api/combos` requests for users who only want standalone models. *(Credit: Backported with attribution from upstream
  PR #18135 by @maxmad64bis, MIT License).*
- Inferred free signals via `freeSignals` option (`"declared"`, `"priced"`, `"named"`, `"provider-named"`) and
  `freeProviders`, allowing `freeOnly` to detect free models based on zero pricing ($0) or `-free` naming suffixes,
  labelled `(free, inferred)`. *(Credit: Backported with attribution from upstream PR #16800 by @maxmad64bis, MIT
  License).*
- Non-overlapping background execution with safe timer unref and host cleanup disposal on plugin unload.
- Immediate cache eviction for previous credential keys upon connection credential changes.
- Documented explicit minimum and tested versions for OpenCode V2 (`>=2.1.0`, tested on `2.2.6`) and OmniRoute
  (`>=3.8.52`, tested on `3.8.53`).

### Changed

- Updated `@opencode/plugin` to `2.2.6` and verified full compatibility across OpenCode 2.2.2 through 2.2.6 releases.
- Clarified `modelCacheTtlMs` documentation to describe both cache TTL and background refresh period.

## [0.1.1] - 2026-10-21

### Added

- Official repository, homepage, and issue tracker metadata in `package.json`.
- Exported subpath `./server` in `package.json` for OpenCode runtime loaders.
- Expanded discoverability keywords in `package.json` (`ai-agent`, `coding-agent`, `ai-gateway`, `model-router`,
  `web-search`, `web-fetch`).
- Automated GitHub Actions CI workflow for test, typecheck, and build steps.
- GitHub Issue Forms with security reminders for bug reports and feature requests.
- Dependabot configuration for weekly dependency and GitHub Actions updates.

### Fixed

- Replaced residual private provider names in comments and fixtures with generic examples, preventing leaks in compiled
  declaration files (`dist/*.d.ts`).
- Included `supportsThinking` in model capability reasoning mapping in `src/shared/models-map.ts`.
- Propagated per-request timeout in `OmniRouteWebClient.fetch`, bounding requests to caller-defined timeouts and
  forwarding `timeout` in request bodies.
- Validated search queries in `OmniRouteWebClient.search` to reject empty or whitespace queries before network
  roundtrips.
- Supported string content and camelCase `publishedAt` timestamp fields in search result processing.
- Handled empty content responses (e.g. 404 pages) in web fetch without throwing.

## [0.1.0] - 2026-10-21

### Added

- Initial release of `@devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin`.
- Dynamic OmniRoute model catalog discovery with OpenCode V2 plugin architecture.
- Automatic filtering of non-chat models (image generators, embeddings, video, audio, rerank).
- Dual-level reasoning effort tier discovery with native OpenCode variants (`low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`).
- Provider-first model naming (`Provider - Model Name`) with clean repository prefix stripping.
- Suppression of false `Free` badges on unpriced models (`cost: []`), preserving `[Free]` only for genuine free models.
- Usable-only upstream provider filtering (`usableOnly: true`).
- Optional REST-based web search (`/v1/search`) and web fetch (`/v1/web/fetch`) tools with native permission assertions
  and automatic fallback.
- Single API key configuration for inference, web tools, and metadata.
- In-memory TTL cache with on-disk warm startup snapshot.

# Configuration

`@devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin` connects OpenCode to an OmniRoute gateway. It publishes the gateway's model catalog,
fixes custom-provider identity, and can optionally route OpenCode's native web tools through OmniRoute REST.

```json
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "@devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin",
      "options": {
        "baseURL": "http://localhost:20128",
        "apiKey": "…"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Requirements

| Component           | Minimum Version               | Tested / Aligned Version      | Notes                                                |
|---------------------|-------------------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| OpenCode V2         | `>=2.1.0`                     | `2.2.7` (also `2.2.0`–`2.2.6`)| Defined in `peerDependencies` as `>=2.1.0 <3`        |
| OmniRoute gateway   | `>=3.8.52`                    | `3.8.53`                      | Full inference, pricing/metadata, and REST web tools |
| Node.js / Bun       | Node `>=22.22.3` / Bun `>=1.4.0` | Node `22.20.5` / Bun `1.4.4`  | Node 22 LTS or Bun 1.4+                              |

## One key

The plugin uses exactly one credential: the key that connects OpenCode to OmniRoute. The same value authenticates
`/v1/models`, `/v1/search`, `/v1/web/fetch`, and every `/api/*` metadata request.

Resolution order: `apiKey` option, then `OMNIROUTE_API_KEY`.

There is no management-token option. If that key has no management scope, the gateway refuses `/api/*` and the plugin
publishes the served catalog without enrichment: no display names, no provider markers beyond what `/v1/models` gives
you, no pricing overlay, and `usableOnly` falls back to keeping every model. Models keep working; only metadata
degrades. The plugin logs one line naming the endpoint and what is lost.

Credentials are never logged. Avoid putting keys in a committed `opencode.json`; `opencode auth` or the environment is
preferable.

## Options

Unknown keys are rejected with a message naming the key, because a silently ignored option is worse than a load failure.

| Option               | Default             | Meaning                                                                |
|----------------------|---------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `baseURL`            | — (required)        | Gateway URL, with or without a trailing `/v1`                          |
| `apiKey`             | `OMNIROUTE_API_KEY` | The one key, used for every endpoint                                   |
| `providerId`         | `omniroute`         | OpenCode provider id and model-ID prefix                               |
| `displayName`        | `OmniRoute`         | Provider name, also used as the websearch provider name                |
| `usableOnly`         | `true`              | Keep only models the gateway can actually route                        |
| `enrichment`         | `true`              | Fetch names, prices and free-tier data from `/api/*`                   |
| `providerTag`        | `true`              | Append the served prefix to every model title                          |
| `visibleModels`      | all                 | Allowlist by full id, bare suffix, or branch wildcard (`prefix/*`); `"*"` disables |
| `hiddenModels`       | none                | Denylist by full id, bare suffix, or branch wildcard (`prefix/*`)      |
| `providersAllow`     | none                | Keep only these upstream providers (supports branch wildcards `prefix/*`) |
| `combos`             | `true`              | Publish combos; set to `false` to hide every combo and skip `/api/combos` |
| `combosSource`       | `"api"`             | `"api"` folds `/api/combos`; `"models"` skips it                       |
| `freeOnly`           | `false`             | Publish free-tier models only                                          |
| `freeSignals`        | `["declared"]`      | Signals for `freeOnly`: `"declared"`, `"priced"`, `"named"`, `"provider-named"` |
| `freeProviders`      | none                | Provider prefixes admitted as free under the `provider-named` signal   |
| `toolsOnly`          | `false`             | Publish tool-calling models only                                       |
| `visionOnly`         | `false`             | Publish vision models only                                             |
| `modelCacheTtlMs`    | `300000`            | Catalog cache lifetime and background refresh interval (minimum 60000 ms) |
| `timeoutMs`          | `10000`             | Default per-request timeout                                            |
| `timeouts`           | —                   | Per-endpoint overrides: `models`, `combos`, `autoCombos`, `enrichment` |
| `usageMemory`        | `true`              | Restore recently used models the default view dropped                  |
| `logLevel`           | `"warn"`            | `error`, `warn`, `info`, `debug`                                       |
| `startupDebug`       | `false`             | Force debug logging at startup                                         |
| `apiFormat`          | —                   | `allowAnthropic`, `anthropicModels`, `anthropicPrefixes`               |
| `geminiSanitization` | `true`              | Strip tool-schema keywords Gemini rejects                              |
| `telemetry`          | `false`             | Mark inference telemetry on the SDK options                            |
| `web`                | both off            | See below                                                              |

### Web tools

Search and fetch are independent, and both are off by default.

```json
{
  "web": {
    "timeoutMs": 30000,
    "search": {
      "enabled": false,
      "maxResults": 5
    },
    "fetch": {
      "enabled": false,
      "fallbackToNative": true,
      "includeMetadata": true
    }
  }
}
```

`web.search.enabled` registers OmniRoute as an OpenCode web-search provider and selects it. It only calls
`POST /v1/search`; it never changes your other tools.

`web.fetch.enabled` replaces OpenCode's built-in `webfetch` with a gateway-backed one for every caller. Because that is
a bigger change than adding a provider, it is a separate switch. The replacement:

- asks for the same `webfetch` permission, with the URL as the resource, before any request — a denial is never turned
  into a gateway request;
- keeps the native input and output shape, including the 1..120 second timeout;
- maps the native `text` format to the gateway's `markdown` (the gateway serves `markdown`, `html`, `links` and
  `screenshot`, and has no plain-text format);
- falls back to the captured built-in tool when the gateway fails, unless `fallbackToNative` is `false`;
- does not fall back when the turn itself was cancelled.

Both tools omit the `provider` field on purpose. OmniRoute then selects among the search/fetch providers its operator
configured and handles failover. The plugin adds no routing heuristics of its own.

MCP is not involved: the plugin never registers, replaces, or requires an OmniRoute MCP server.

## Display names

Titles lead with the provider name followed by the model name:

```text
CustomProvider - Deepseek v4.1 Flash
[Free] CustomProvider - Deepseek v4.1 Flash · 25M tokens/day
```

The provider prefix makes upstream connections findable because OpenCode's picker fuzzy-matches titles.
`providerTag: false` removes the provider prefix.

The provider is never a generated connection ID like `openai-compatible-chat-<uuid>`. For nested IDs behind a known
wrapper namespace like `no-think/custom-provider/...`, the provider is the target upstream connection
(`CustomProvider`), and
the wrapper is preserved in the title as a namespace prefix (`No-think - CustomProvider - ...`).

## Management endpoints and degradation

`/api/providers` drives `usableOnly`, `/api/pricing/models` plus `/api/pricing` drive names and prices, `/api/combos`
drives combos, `/api/free-tier/summary` drives free budgets. Each is optional:

- a refusal or failure keeps the last known value (memory or the on-disk snapshot) and warns once per endpoint;
- with no last known value, the catalog publishes from `/v1/models` alone;
- an empty `/api/providers` answer keeps the full catalog and warns, because "no connections described" is not proof
  that a served prefix is unroutable.

`usableOnly` drops only what it can prove unroutable: a connection that is explicitly disabled, or whose health check
reported something other than `active`. Models whose prefix the gateway never described stay published, because absence
of metadata is not evidence of a broken connection.

# Migration and attribution

## From `@omniroute/opencode-plugin-v2`

```diff
  {
    "plugins": [
      {
-       "package": "@omniroute/opencode-plugin-v2",
+       "package": "@devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin",
        "options": {
          "baseURL": "http://localhost:20128",
          "apiKey": "…",
-         "managementReadToken": "…",
          "usableOnly": true
        }
      }
    ]
  }
```

What changed and why:

| Upstream                                          | Here                                       | Why                                                                                                                                                            |
|---------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `managementReadToken`                             | removed                                    | One key covers `/v1/*` and `/api/*`. A second credential most users do not have.                                                                               |
| `OMNIROUTE_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY`                    | removed                                    | Same reason.                                                                                                                                                   |
| `usableOnly` default `false`                      | default `true`                             | The catalog should show what the gateway can route. The filter only drops proven-unroutable providers, so an inference-only key still yields the full catalog. |
| Titles like `custom-provider - DeepSeek V4 Flash` | `CustomProvider - DeepSeek V4 Flash`       | Provider first with operator casing (nodeName), humanized names, and clean repo prefixes.                                                                      |
| Plugin id `omniroute-v2`                          | `opencode-omniroute`                       | Distinct plugin, distinct id.                                                                                                                                  |
| Web tools require an MCP server                   | `web.search` / `web.fetch`, off by default | Direct REST, no MCP, no second credential.                                                                                                                     |

Options keep their upstream names and meanings otherwise: `providerId`, `baseURL`, `apiKey`, `displayName`,
`visibleModels`, `hiddenModels`, `providersAllow`, `combosSource`, `freeOnly`, `toolsOnly`, `visionOnly`,
`modelCacheTtlMs`, `timeoutMs`, `timeouts`, `usageMemory`, `logLevel`, `startupDebug`, `apiFormat`,
`geminiSanitization`, `telemetry`, `providerTag`, `enrichment`.

No runtime aliases are provided for removed keys: a config that still carries `managementReadToken` fails to load and
names the unknown key, which is the intended outcome. Delete the line.

The two packages are independent. Remove the upstream one from `plugins` before enabling this one, so the same models
are not published twice.

## From the local `omniroute-prefix-titles` workaround

A local plugin that re-prefixed titles existed to make custom-provider models searchable. This package does that itself,
from the served prefix, so remove that plugin from `plugins`. Keeping both would double the marker
(`CustomProvider - CustomProvider - DeepSeek V4 Flash` is avoided, but two plugins writing the same titles is still a
race).

The workaround's option names do not exist here. Anything it needed beyond `baseURL` and `apiKey` belongs in the options
table in [`configuration.md`](configuration.md).

## Removing the manual OmniRoute MCP server

Once `web.search` or `web.fetch` is enabled and verified, the OmniRoute MCP server entry in your OpenCode config is
redundant. This plugin does not remove it, and it does not load it either: delete it yourself when you no longer use it
for other tools. With the web tools disabled, keep it if you rely on it.
